notes: Three eligible food-truck-focus tools with HUF prices on their own sites (Orderly, QRM.hu, StandMágus/OnlineMágus), so eSystem (restaurant) is likely surplus under the 2+ food-truck rule. Period caveats: QRM's 8 900 HUF ordering-module line and StandMágus's 'SM Max 16 800 Ft-tól' line state no period themselves; 'month' comes from other lines on the same page (see plan notes). eSystem's /arak gives a per-day price ('napi 320 Ft + ÁFA'), while the home-page summary listed monthly prices; those were not quoted. Orderly's 0.5% commission is on its own online ordering; whether the webshop sits in the 6 990 Ft base fee is not stated. Happy Gastro is JavaScript-only (unreadable); Choice answered 403 (tried once). Both web searches returned mostly non-Hungarian vendors; nothing new was added from them (ZunaPro, a website builder, was not checked).
